facts.behavior: scope.State的实际键是(ProcedureId,module,node)，状态属于方案root；无scope时fallback键为规范化BaseDirectory加node，保留于插件实例。Runtime只保留owner且不实现Dispose，不随单轮运行器结束清队列。Reset只从fallback移除指定node，并不移除scope状态。RemoveNode移除状态后只对IDisposable调用Dispose，缓存State不实现该接口。根scope关闭先取消，待租约归零后清状态字典；该State也不会执行逐帧Dispose。
facts.representation: State.Queue是独立持有者；scope和fallback两条路径不可混用Reset解释。
facts.cache: RetainProcedureNodes通过RemoveNode清除不再存在的状态键。
facts.release: 移除缓存引用依靠托管GC；旧ModuleResult仍可持图，不能称立即归还全部像素内存。

refs.excerpt: State GetState(ModuleExecutionContext c){if(c.Scope is {} scope)return scope.State(Id,c.NodeId,()=>new State());lock(gate){string key=Path.GetFullPath(c.BaseDirectory)+"|"+c.NodeId;if(!fallback.TryGetValue(key,out var state))fallback[key]=state=new();return state;}}
public void Reset(string nodeId){lock(gate)foreach(string key in fallback.Keys.Where(k=>k.EndsWith("|"+nodeId,StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToArray())fallback.Remove(key);}
sealed class Runtime(ImageBufferPlugin owner):IModule {

public void RemoveNode(string module,string node){var root=Root;object? value;lock(root.gate){root.effectiveParameters.Remove((ProcedureId,module,node));if(!root.states.Remove((ProcedureId,module,node),out value))return;}if(value is IDisposable disposable)disposable.Dispose();}

void Release(){object[] values;lock(gate){values=states.Values.Concat(ownedServices).Distinct(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance).ToArray();states.Clear();effectiveParameters.Clear();services.Clear();ownedServices.Clear();}foreach(var value in values)if(value is IDisposable disposable)try{disposable.Dispose();}catch(Exception error){RecordCleanupFailure("resource",value,error);}try{stopping.Dispose();}catch(Exception error){RecordCleanupFailure("token",stopping,error);}}
